metadata.description: One-stop SDLC orchestration for Claude Code - automatic agent and skill routing across the full development lifecycle

plugins.name: onestop
plugins.description: Describe what you want in plain language. onestop plans the phases and dispatches the right specialist for each - requirements, design, code, tests, web and app automation, review, ship - stopping at every gate for your approval. A pipeline engine enforces the gates, retry budgets and safety rules in code; technology and version choices and everything that reaches git stay yours.
